name: Creator payouts
idea: Pay every creator their weekly share in one transaction, with a memo on each payment and the activity credited to your app.

name: Pay a name
idea: Send USDC to alice.base.eth and see it confirmed in the next 200ms block.

name: Fair airdrop
idea: Drop a new token to real people only: one claim per verified person, checked by the contract.

name: Members-only fund
idea: A tokenized fund only approved investors can hold, whose balances update correctly for splits.

name: Agent data market
idea: Sell data per call to AI agents that stay inside their spend limits, with every agent credited onchain.

name: Metered AI API
idea: An AI API that holds a maximum, then charges only for the exact usage, timed to the millisecond.

name: Private payroll
idea: Run payroll without publishing every salary, with each payment tagged to its pay period.

name: Escrow marketplace
idea: Verified buyers pay into escrow, sellers get paid on delivery with the platform fee split out, and returns refund in one click.

name: Borrow to pay
idea: Borrow USDC against ETH, swap if needed, and pay a merchant without selling your ETH.

name: Gas-free onboarding
idea: New users connect, bring funds in, and make their first payment in one tap with the app paying fees.

name: Live merchant screen
idea: A shop counter screen that flips to Paid the moment payment lands, with a clean end-of-day report.

name: Stablecoin ops desk
idea: An issuer console to mint a stablecoin, put a hold on one account, pause in an incident, and match every move to its record.
